questions.q: The rhythm of the spoken English language is best described as:
questions.explain: English is a stress-timed language, meaning the intervals between stressed syllables are roughly equal, causing unstressed syllables to be compressed or spoken more rapidly.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: What does it mean to say that English is a 'stress-timed' language?
options: Every syllable takes the exact same amount of time to say.
The duration between stressed syllables is roughly equal.
Only nouns are ever spoken out loud.
Sentences end on a specific pitch regardless of length.
questions.explain: In a stress-timed language like English, the time it takes to go from one stressed syllable to the next is approximately the same, causing unstressed syllables in between to be spoken quicker.
